execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."auditoria" (
  "accion" character varying(80) NOT NULL,
  "creado_en" timestamptz,
  "detalle" character varying(1000),
  "entidad" character varying(80) NOT NULL,
  "entidad_id" int8,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "usuario_id" int8,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."cliente_servicio" (
  "cliente_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  "estado" character varying(30) NOT NULL,
  "fecha_inicio" date,
  "fecha_termino" date,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "servicio_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."clientes" (
  "actualizado_en" timestamptz,
  "contacto_principal" character varying(120),
  "creado_en" timestamptz,
  "direccion" character varying(250),
  "email_contacto" character varying(150),
  "estado" character varying(30) NOT NULL,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nombre_razon_social" character varying(180) NOT NULL,
  "rut" character varying(20) NOT NULL,
  "telefono" character varying(30),
  "tipo_cliente" character varying(20) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."documentos" (
  "cargado_en" timestamptz,
  "cargado_por" int8 NOT NULL,
  "cliente_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  "estado" character varying(30) NOT NULL,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "mime_type" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "nombre_archivo" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "observacion" character varying(1000),
  "periodo_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  "tamano_bytes" int8 NOT NULL,
  "tipo_documento_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  "url_archivo" character varying(500) NOT NULL,
  "visible_cliente" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."gestiones" (
  "actualizado_en" timestamptz,
  "cliente_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  "creado_en" timestamptz,
  "creado_por" int8,
  "descripcion" character varying(1000),
  "estado" character varying(30) NOT NULL,
  "fecha_vencimiento" date,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "periodo_id" int8,
  "responsable_id" int8,
  "servicio_id" int8,
  "tipo" character varying(80),
  "titulo" character varying(180) NOT NULL,
  "visible_cliente" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."periodos_cliente" (
  "anio" int2 NOT NULL,
  "cerrado" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "cliente_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  "creado_en" timestamptz,
  "estado_contable" character varying(30) NOT NULL,
  "fecha_vencimiento" date,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "mes" int2 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."proyecciones_f29" (
  "documento_generado" int8,
  "estado" character varying(30) NOT NULL,
  "generado_en" timestamptz,
  "generado_por" int8,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "impuesto_estimado" numeric(14,2) NOT NULL,
  "iva_credito" numeric(14,2) NOT NULL,
  "iva_debito" numeric(14,2) NOT NULL,
  "periodo_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  "ppm" numeric(14,2) NOT NULL,
  "remanente_anterior" numeric(14,2) NOT NULL,
  "retenciones" numeric(14,2) NOT NULL,
  "revisado_por" int8,
  "total_estimado" numeric(14,2) NOT NULL,
  "version" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."roles" (
  "descripcion" character varying(150),
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nombre" character varying(30) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."servicios" (
  "activo" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "descripcion" character varying(250),
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nombre" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."tipos_documento" (
  "activo" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "area" character varying(30) NOT NULL,
  "descripcion" character varying(250),
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nombre" character varying(140) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."trabajadores" (
  "cargo" character varying(120) NOT NULL,
  "cliente_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  "creado_en" timestamptz,
  "estado" character varying(30) NOT NULL,
  "fecha_ingreso" date NOT NULL,
  "fecha_termino" date,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nombre" character varying(150) NOT NULL,
  "rut" character varying(20) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."transacciones" (
  "categoria" character varying(100),
  "cliente_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  "creado_en" timestamptz,
  "creado_por" int8,
  "descripcion" character varying(300) NOT NULL,
  "direccion" character varying(15) NOT NULL,
  "estado_revision" character varying(30) NOT NULL,
  "fecha" date NOT NULL,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "iva" numeric(14,2) NOT NULL,
  "monto_exento" numeric(14,2) NOT NULL,
  "monto_neto" numeric(14,2) NOT NULL,
  "monto_total" numeric(14,2) NOT NULL,
  "observacion" character varying(1000),
  "periodo_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  "revisado_en" timestamptz,
  "revisado_por" int8,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."usuario_cliente" (
  "cliente_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  "es_principal" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "usuario_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("usuario_id", "cliente_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."usuarios" (
  "activo" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "actualizado_en" timestamptz,
  "creado_en" timestamptz,
  "email" character varying(150),
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nombre" character varying(120) NOT NULL,
  "nombre_usuario" character varying(80) NOT NULL,
  "password_hash" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "rol_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
